regions.label: Full-bleed animated fluid-smoke canvas with giant pixel-dithered 'ZestSend' wordmark, rotating tagline 'Anonymously [write together/share screen/send files…] with end-to-end encryption', four underline digit inputs for a connection code, icon nav (language/settings/about) and credits — blurred behind the dialog

Centered 'Appearance' modal with close button and a scrolling list of 10 named colour themes, each a row with name, joke description and three colour swatch bars; selected row has accent left border, accent title and check

structure.layout: single-screen full-bleed hero app (no header) with centered wordmark, tagline and connection-code input; captured with a centered modal settings dialog over a blurred backdrop

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack throughout: bold wide-tracked headings and option names, small letter-spaced descriptions; giant hero wordmark rendered as dithered pixel canvas
aesthetics.typeScale: High contrast: ~170px canvas wordmark, 48px/700 tagline, 24px/700 dialog title, 18px/700 option names, 15px subtitle, 12px descriptions; generous letter-spacing

notes: Background is a live WebGL fluid/smoke simulation tinted by the active theme (switching to Solar Ember turns it to fire orange instantly). Wordmark 'ZestSend' is rendered as a dithered/noisy pixel canvas. Tagline verb rotates (write together / share screen / talk / listen / draw / send files) with emoji-like icons; 'end-to-end encryption' in mint green with lock. Dialog: square-edged full-bleed theme rows inside a 16px-radius dark glass panel; each row ends in three tall swatch columns (bg / mid / accent) flush to the right edge; selected row gets accent-colored title, 2px left border and check. Witty descriptions per theme ('Mouthwash for your bandwidth'). Credits link text uses a scrambled/duplicated-letter animation.
